moncab.description: Joined as the sole dev intern, autonomous on the whole codebase in 3-4 weeks. Built the invitation system, v2 search algorithm (weighted scoring, 6 factors), Pennylane billing integration (invoicing, dynamic VAT, webhooks), Ubiflow listing syndication, owner dashboard with payment stats, multiple Stripe security passes. 113+ commits in ~2 months.

setupkit.title: SetupKit
setupkit.description: Educational SaaS that helps developers and teams take back control over their AI coding tools by generating complete configuration architectures (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, commands, skills) tailored to their stack and workflows.

nali.title: Nali
nali.description: Existing project management tools are overengineered for small dev teams. I built a lighter alternative with multi-org management, Kanban + sprints, real-time messaging, AES-256 encrypted docs, GitHub integration, WebRTC video calls, Stripe billing with 4 plans.

irc.title: IRC
irc.description: IRC server in C++ with non-blocking TCP sockets. Multi-client handling, authentication, channels, real-time messaging.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Full-stack web app. Real-time multiplayer Pong via WebSockets, auth, chat, stats, match history.

music_room.title: Music_Room
music_room.description: Mobile music sharing app in React Native and Node.js. Collaborative playlists, events, voting, personalized profiles.

matcha.title: Matcha
matcha.description: Matcha is a social dating application. It allows users to create profiles, browse other profiles, send messages, and find matches based on shared interests. The application incorporates features such as geolocation, user preferences, and a real-time notification system. The project implements a full-stack architecture with a backend API, a database for user management, and an interactive frontend for an engaging user experience.

learn2slither.title: Learn2Slither
learn2slither.description: A snake that learns to survive and feed autonomously using Q-Learning. Local vision, Q-table, exploration/exploitation, trained from scratch with no ML library.

linear_regression.title: Linear_Regression
linear_regression.description: Car price prediction program using linear regression with gradient descent algorithm, implemented from scratch in Python.
